name: Ringsback
short: Missed-call text-back console: the text goes out, the reply lands here.
long: A live feed of today's calls — answered, missed, missed then texted then replied then booked — with the exact message that went out and how many seconds after the call it left. Press "Simulate a missed call" and you watch the whole thing happen: the phone rings out, a countdown runs, the text sends, and a minute later the customer replies.
proves: The customer gets a text before they've finished leaving a voicemail.
features: Live feed of nineteen calls today seeded against the real clock, each missed one showing its auto-text and the seconds it took
Simulate a missed call: rings out, counts down in the row, sends, then the customer replies on their own
Conversation threads with quick replies and a booking link that marks the thread booked when it is opened
Hours, three message templates and per-line settings that save; a weekly recovered report with a hairline bar chart
story: Every trade loses work to a phone that rang while they were under a floor. This is the smallest tool that fixes it — and the only way to show it is to let someone press the button and watch the text go.
